description: This file defines a Python class '_OPTIONAL_PresidioPIIMasking' that extends 'CustomGuardrail' and implements PII masking using Microsoft Presidio. It includes methods for analyzing and anonymizing text for PII detection and masking, handling streaming responses, and integrating with guardrail infrastructure. It manages external API calls to Presidio services, processes analysis results, and provides hooks for pre- and post-call processing, including logging and response modifications.
